top_signals.title: Hackers compromise 14,500 Dahua web cameras in 35-day campaign
top_signals.summary: In a large-scale campaign that researchers dubbed CameraSwarm, hackers compromised more than 14,500 Dahua IP cameras mostly in Ukraine and Russia. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Asian School Chain Founder Seeks $300 Million for PE Buyout Fund
top_signals.summary: A newly launched private equity firm is seeking up to $300 million for its debut fund to acquire school assets across Asia and the Middle East, the latest attempt to capitalize on demand from rich families for quality education.

top_signals.title: Inside India newsletter: Chip squeeze hits Chinese smartphones in India as Apple, Samsung gain an edge
top_signals.summary: Rising memory chip costs are reshaping the world's second-largest smartphone market as Chinese brands become expensive, improving the value proposition for Samsung and Apple.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Cut student loan repayments to get youths out of chicken shops
top_signals.summary: Crippling student loan repayments have stolen billions from the economy sending struggling graduates to cheap food options and public transport, a consultancy firm has argued.  Analysts at Baringa found that cutting the student loan repayment rate from nine per cent to five per cent would free up to £6bn in consumer spending each year for [...]
